readerCopy.body: One side keeps asking questions while the other treats every question as a delay. The planner points to missing information, changing terms, and risks that have not been answered; the operator points to the clock and the cost of waiting. Mercury holds the need to understand and document the move, while Mars gives equal force to the demand for immediate action. The opposition puts explanation and execution across from each other with no room for a vague compromise. A decision may be made, but the result shows whether the team acted with enough information or simply ran out of patience.
